name: Ana Alice - Friendly & Clear
description: A clear and pleasant Brazilian Portuguese voice. Friendly and relatable, it is perfect for engaging social media, YouTube and TikTok videos, podcasts, and educational content. Your audience will love the casual, inviting tone of this voice.

name: Roberta - Casual, Engaging and Clear
description: Engaging female voice, perfect for boosting conversions in infoproducts, VSLs, and social media content. Delivers credibility, emotion, conversational and connection, ideal for sales storytelling and digital branding.

name: Marianne - Sweet, Calm and Clear
description:
A young Brazilian female with a sweet, calm voice and neutral accent.
Specialized on media (youtube, instagram, memes, tiktok, etc) and storytelling/narration (books, articles, news, dubbing, etc).

name: Amandoca - Fun, Breathy and Vibrant
description: Fun, communicative voice with a feminine tone. Good diction, add some accent, with a breathy voice to improve interactivity and make it more realistic, and light noises.

name: Alexa - Soft, Clear and Friendly
description: A young Brazilian female voice with a soft, natural tone. Warm, clear, and friendly, with a neutral Brazilian Portuguese accent. The delivery is smooth and expressive, conveying authenticity and emotional connection. Ideal for voiceovers that require a modern, approachable, and gentle presence perfect for apps, narration, and conversational content.

name: Dani - Warm Brazilian Social Media Voice
description:
Dani is a warm, engaging female voice with a natural 
Rio de Janeiro (carioca) accent — full of personality 
and authentic Brazilian charm.

Perfect for Social Media narration, educational content, 
motivational videos, storytelling, and faceless channels.

Key qualities: Warm, clear, natural carioca accent, 
engaging and easy to listen to.

Best for: YouTube, explainer videos, voiceovers 
in Brazilian Portuguese.

name: Carla - Rural, Dynamic and Articulate
description: Brazilian woman with a countryside São Paulo accent, salesperson, great for VSL, dynamic speaker, articulate, also excellent for social media.

name: Carla - Playful, Spirited and Fun
description: A young, energetic Brazilian female voice full of enthusiasm! Perfect for kids' content on YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok. Carla is the fun host who loves to play, tell stories, and create exciting challenges with high energy. Great for entertaining children with creativity, joy, and imagination!

name: Beatriz - Warm and Natural
description: A smooth, warm female voice with a natural Brazilian Portuguese accent.

name: Isabel - Informative
description: A young Brazilian Portuguese speaker with a bright, engaging quality and a relaxed delivery. She brings everyday relatability to tech reviews, product comparisons, tutorials, and explainer content where clarity and approachability matter most.

name: Ana Claudia
description: Calm Portuguese female voice.

name: Bruna - Energetic and Vibrant
description: A bright, energetic female voice with a natural Brazilian Portuguese accent.

name: Clarice Rodrigues - Deep female announcer
description: A deep female voice—like that of a 40-year-old woman or a professional announcer—but tailored for social media videos.

name: Juliana Katrein - Relaxed, Friendly
description: Brazilian Portuguese female voice, late 20s to mid 30s, architect. Medium pitch (~205 Hz), warm, soft, smooth timbre, no harshness. Conversational, like a friendly voice note: relaxed, sincere, confident, not announcer-like. Moderate, thoughtful pace with frequent short natural pauses; clear articulation. Gentle rises on emphasis, falling end of sentences, slight smile. Soft southern Brazilian (Pelotas, RS) accent. Clean, intimate recording, no reverb or noise.

name: Jully - Calm & Young
description: A great voice for testimonials and UGC.

name: Flavia
description: A female Brazilian voice, aged 30 to 40, for your creative assets.

name: Alice - Brazilian Creator
description: Energetic and approachable with a youthful warmth that feels natural and engaging.

name: Maria ReVoz
description: A natural, clear, and expressive female voice with a warm, professional tone. It features fluid speech, crisp diction, and a balanced pace, conveying both credibility and approachability. Ideal for narrations, videos, online courses, podcasts, and educational, motivational, or corporate content.

name: Monica - Bright, Clear
description: A Brazilian female voice with a bright timbre and an intimate, conversational quality. Mônica combines clear diction, a moderate pace, and well-placed pauses that give the message room to breathe. Her expressive intonation adds a friendly touch to explanations and a sense of conviction to calls to action. Ideal for digital ads, sales videos, product demonstrations, and tutorials—a welcoming presence for presenting offers and explaining how things work with clarity and confidence. Try it with your script.

name: Jessie - Social Lives
description: A great voice for social media lives

name: Zara - The Warm, Real-World Conversationalist
description:
Zara is a female voice, 20s–30s, blends warmth, clarity, and confident expression. Ideal for creators and brands who want their content to feel real, relatable, and human.

Trained across multiple formats including storytelling, ads, social media, tutorials, and casual dialogue, Zara adapts seamlessly to your tone.

Whether guiding, selling, or narrating, Zara builds trust, relatability, and connection from the very first word.

Friendly, grounded, expressive - ready to elevate your content.

name: Saira - Young influencer voice
description: Saira delivers an energetic, youthful, and engaging tone designed for modern social media storytelling. Her lively delivery captures attention quickly while keeping content fun, natural, and relatable. Ideal for reels, influencer content, lifestyle storytelling, brand collaborations, viral short-form videos, and creator-led social media campaigns where energy and personality drive audience engagement. Works especially well for fast-paced digital content and high-retention social media narration.

name: Larisa Actrisa - Confident and Clear
description: Young Russian female with a gentle voice, perfect for social media use case.

name: Ninoska - Bright, Genuine and Friendly
description: A friendly, natural and pleasant female voice with a neutral Spanish accent. Ideal for Audio Books, Narrations, Podcasts and much more!

name: Halley
description: Young American female voice, clean and easy to listen to. Perfect for Youtube videos, social media content, explainer videos, advertisements, tours, and educational content.
